name: ARAM: Mayhem: Extra Expansion Pack / 海克斯大乱斗：额外拓展包
author: Natsuki
description:
Adds more distinctive supporter-created content to ARAM: Mayhem, including extra Hextech Runes, forgers, enchantments, and an event. Requires the ARAM: Mayhem main mod.
为海克斯大乱斗加入一批风格更独立的赞助者内容，包括额外的海克斯符文、锻造器、附魔与事件。需要同时启用海克斯大乱斗本体。
